clauses.title: Scope – Requirements regarding material,
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements regarding material, dimensions, manufacture and finish of rim latches for general use.

clauses.title: Handling of Rim Latches
clauses.text: 2. Handling of Rim Latches— Left hand latch if fitted on left hand door. Right hand latch if fitted on right hand door.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 3. Types Type 1— Opens when handle is turned in one direction only. Type 2 — Opens when hande is turned in any direction.

clauses.title: Type 1 rim latches
clauses.text: 3.1 Type 1 rim latches shall either be 'left-hand' or 'righthand'.

clauses.title: Sizes – 75, 100,
clauses.text: 4. Sizes - 75, 100, 125 and 150 mm denoted by overall length of the body measured from the outside face of the fore end to the rear end.

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 5. Material  -  Shall be of the mild steel, brass, aluminium alloy or zinc base alloy.

clauses.title: Dimensions (in mm)
clauses.text: 6. Dimensions (in mm) Size       Length × Breadth × Depth 75 75 × 60 × 14 100 100 × 70 × 20 125 125 × 70 × 20 150 150 × 70 × 20 Tolerance + 1 mm 6. Finish Brass latches Bright or satin finish Aluminium latches Anodized finish Steel latches Black japanned, stove enamelled black or copper  oxidoized.

clauses.title: Performance Requirement
clauses.text: 8. Performance Requirement — When knob of latch is turned, the catch bolt shall draw smoothly into  the body and shall be flush with the face of the body. Note— For requirements for material  of rim latches  see Table 1 of the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS 1019 : 1974 Specification for rim latches (second revision)
